general-unknown.def: honest and behaving in a way most people think is right; also good enough
general-unknown.ex: He is controlling, but a decent man.

mnem.story: Desantchi yigit halol va insofli (decent) bo'lib chiqdi — hech kimni aldamadi.

general-unknown.def: to make short knocking sounds, as when something loose shakes
senses: to make someone nervous (to rattle someone)
general-unknown.ex: The window kept rattling in the wind.

mnem.story: Temir ratl yuk mashinasi orqasida taraqlab (rattle) ketdi.

general-unknown.def: to breathe in noisily through the nose, usually while crying or with a cold
general-unknown.ex: She sniffled quietly as she listened to the statement.

mnem.story: Shamollagan bola piq-piq burnini tortdi (sniffle).

general-unknown.def: to speak about something in a way that shows you think it is stupid
general-unknown.ex: He scoffed at the idea that psychics are real.

mnem.story: Kofeni ho'plab turib, u mening rejamni masxara qildi (scoff).

general-unknown.def: to make low, weak crying sounds
senses: (of a dog) to make soft frightened noises
general-unknown.ex: She whimpered as her husband shouted at the agent.

mnem.story: Kuchukcha eshik ortida 'ving-ving' ingradi (whimper).

general-unknown.form: what is the matter with you
general-unknown.def: used to ask what is wrong with someone, often angrily
general-unknown.uz: senga nima bo'ldi?, nima qilyapsan o'zi?
general-unknown.ex: "June, what's the matter with you?" he shouted.

mnem.story: Materiya buzilgandek qiyshaygan do'stimga: 'Senga nima bo'ldi?' dedim.

general-unknown.def: a small official sign you wear to show who you are; for police, the symbol of the job itself
senses: a sign or mark of something (a badge of honour)
general-unknown.ex: "I'm going to have your badge!" — I will get you fired.

mnem.story: Bej rangli nishon (badge) ko'ylagida porlab turardi — u politsiyachi edi.

general-unknown.def: extremely unhappy or unpleasant
general-unknown.ex: I am going to make life miserable for you!

mnem.story: Mazasi yo'q, sovuq, yomg'irli kun — haqiqiy 'miserable' kun.

general-unknown.def: to go up to a stranger and speak to them in a rude or threatening way
general-unknown.uz: yo'lini to'sib gap qotmoq, bezorilik bilan yaqinlashmoq
senses: to approach someone aggressively for money
general-unknown.ex: You come in here. You accost my wife. You cause trouble.

mnem.story: Noma'lum odam yonimga (qo'st) kelib yo'limni to'sdi (accost).

general-unknown.def: to pull back the hammer of a gun so it is ready to fire
senses: to cock your head = to tilt it
general-unknown.ex: He cocked the pistol and stepped back.

mnem.story: Tepkini 'qoq' etib tortdi (cock) — endi qurol otishga tayyor.

general-unknown.def: to make a short low sound in your throat, showing effort or that you do not want to talk
senses: (noun, informal) a low-ranking soldier or worker
general-unknown.ex: He just grunted and carried the box upstairs.

mnem.story: Og'ir qopni ko'tarayotgan odam 'g'ur-g'ur' qilib xirilladi (grunt).

general-unknown.def: to make a loud, high, unpleasant sound
general-unknown.ex: The tyres screeched as the car turned the corner.

mnem.story: Tormoz 'chiyyy' deb chiyilladi (screech), mashina to'xtadi.

general-unknown.def: the clothes and things a bride collects for her marriage; used here as a joke about too much luggage
general-unknown.ex: "When your trousseau arrives, pick up the second rental car."

mnem.story: Kelin turli-tuman sepini (trousseau) chamadonga bosib tiqdi.

general-unknown.def: being officially stopped from doing your job for a period of time, as a punishment
senses: the system of springs in a car
a mixture of solid bits in liquid
general-unknown.ex: "Go away. You're on suspension."

mnem.story: Ishdan chetlatilgan (suspension) xodim havoda osilib qolgandek his qildi.

general-unknown.def: (informal, rude) a stupid or annoying person
general-unknown.ex: "Which one of you jackasses told him?"

mnem.story: Eshak (ass) kabi qaysar odamni amerikaliklar 'jackass' deydi.

general-unknown.def: to do something good that makes people forgive your earlier mistake
senses: to exchange a coupon or voucher for something
general-unknown.ex: "Sorry I went over your head. I'll redeem myself."

mnem.story: Xatosini re-dim (qayta tiklash) qilib, yaxshi ish bilan o'zini oqladi (redeem).

general-unknown.def: the act of saving yourself from blame or sin by doing something good
senses: (finance) paying back a debt or cashing in a bond
general-unknown.ex: "If you want redemption, be silent."

mnem.story: Qamoqdan chiqqach, butun umrini yaxshilikka bag'ishlab, redemption topdi.

general-unknown.form: was subdued with a stun gun
general-unknown.def: to bring someone under control by force
general-unknown.ex: The victim was subdued with a stun gun before the attack.

mnem.story: Politsiyachi do'q urib, jinoyatchini bo'ysundirdi (subdue).

general-unknown.def: a weapon that gives an electric shock to make a person unable to move
senses: stun = to shock or amaze someone
general-unknown.ex: Burn marks show the victim was hit with a stun gun.

mnem.story: Shoker (stun gun) tegishi bilan u 'ston' chiqarib qotib qoldi.

general-unknown.def: a cord, strap or tie used to bind something tightly
senses: (medicine) a thread used to tie a blood vessel
general-unknown.ex: Her hands were bound with tight plastic ligatures.

mnem.story: Arqonga o'xshash bog'ich (ligature) bilan qo'llarini mahkam bog'lashdi.

general-unknown.def: wild and uncontrolled, done with violent excitement
general-unknown.ex: The report described a frenzied attack.

mnem.story: Jazavaga tushgan (frenzied) odam xonadagi hamma narsani ag'dar-to'ntar qildi.

general-unknown.def: the main part of the body, without the head, arms and legs
senses: a statue of a body without head or limbs
general-unknown.ex: The wounds were all to the torso.

mnem.story: Haykaltarosh faqat torsni (gavdani) yasab, bosh va qo'lni unutdi.

general-unknown.def: connected with events that science cannot explain, such as ghosts or mind-reading
senses: (noun) the paranormal = such events as a subject
general-unknown.ex: "You're also sort of a paranormal detective, is that right?"

mnem.story: Normadan (normal) tashqari, 'para' hodisalar — arvohlar, telepatiya.

general-unknown.def: a non-standard, old sailor's spelling of "there"
senses: famous in the whalers' cry meaning: there it is!
general-unknown.ex: "Thar she blows" is an old sailors' way of saying "There it is!"

mnem.story: Dengizchi tor qayiqdan turib 'thar!' — ya'ni 'ana u yerda!' deb qichqirdi.

general-unknown.def: (informal) very excited and pleased about something
senses: stoke = to add fuel to a fire; to stoke fear = to increase it
general-unknown.ex: "I'm stoked to finally see one in the flesh."

mnem.story: O't (stoke) yoqilganda olov gurillagandek, u hayajondan yonib ketdi (stoked).

general-unknown.def: the soft part of the body between skin and bone; in the flesh = in real life, in person
general-unknown.uz: go'sht, tana; "in the flesh" = jonli, o'zi
senses: the soft part of a fruit
general-unknown.ex: I'm stoked to finally see one in the flesh.

mnem.story: Fleshkadagi rasmini emas, o'zini jonli (in the flesh) ko'rgani bordim.

general-unknown.def: a strong fear that something bad is going to happen
general-unknown.ex: You see the face on the wall and you feel dread.

mnem.story: Yurakdagi dard aralash qo'rquv — mana dread.

general-unknown.def: an evil spirit that robs graves; also a person who enjoys death and horror too much
general-unknown.uz: go'rkov jin; o'lim va dahshatdan zavq oladigan odam
general-unknown.ex: "You enjoy your work a little too much. You're a ghoul."

mnem.story: Qabristondagi gul orasida kezib, o'liklardan zavq oladigan jin — ghoul.

general-unknown.def: (informal, rude) sexually excited
senses: made of horn; hard like horn
general-unknown.ex: The word is informal and rude — avoid it in exams and formal writing.

mnem.story: Shoxli (horn) shayton tasviri — 'horny' so'zi ham shu shoxdan kelib chiqqan, qo'pol so'z.

general-unknown.def: to annoy or irritate someone
senses: usually used about small, repeated annoyances
general-unknown.ex: "I'm sorry. He irks me."

mnem.story: Erkalangan bola tinmay ming'irlab, hammaning jig'iga tegdi (irk).

general-unknown.def: annoying and tiring, especially over time
senses: often used about tasks and duties
general-unknown.ex: He irks me. He's irksome.

mnem.story: Erkalikning ozi (some) ham jonga tegadi — irksome.

general-unknown.def: having no other place to be, and so staying where you are
general-unknown.ex: "Agent Cho said you'd left town." — "No. Nowhere to go."

mnem.story: Qayerga (where) desang — hech qayerga (no), demak 'nowhere to go'.

general-unknown.forms: means · by all means · by no means
general-unknown.def: certainly, of course — used to agree enthusiastically
senses: by no means = not at all
general-unknown.ex: "That one gets more light." — "That one. More light, by all means."

mnem.story: Yaxshi minezli mezbon: 'Marhamat, bemalol (by all means)!' deb eshikni ochdi.

general-unknown.def: very valuable, or very much loved
general-unknown.ex: "I lost a beautiful, precious angel."

mnem.story: Presda siqilgan qimmatbaho tosh (precious stone) — eng aziz narsa.

general-unknown.def: done secretly, without being officially recorded
general-unknown.uz: rasmiy hujjatsiz, yashirincha, qora yo'l bilan
senses: (of pay) cash in hand, not declared
general-unknown.ex: She asked him to get her the pills off the books.

mnem.story: Daftarga (books) yozilmagan ish — 'off the books', ya'ni yashirin.

general-unknown.def: the act of keeping something hidden from other people
senses: a state of being kept secret
general-unknown.ex: "Why the secrecy?" Lisbon asked.

mnem.story: Sekret hujjat seyfda — butun boshli 'secrecy' shu yerdan boshlanadi.

general-unknown.def: light, unimportant conversation
general-unknown.ex: "I was hoping to get something now. Trying to avoid the chitchat."

mnem.story: Chit ko'ylakli xolalar choy ustida soatlab chit-chat qilishdi.

general-unknown.def: (of a doctor) to say officially what medicine a patient should take
senses: to state officially what must be done
general-unknown.ex: "I wouldn't be comfortable prescribing without some sort of chitchat."

mnem.story: Shifokor oldindan (pre) skript (yozuv) yozib berdi — bu prescription.

general-unknown.def: a player who fails at the crucial moment because of nerves
general-unknown.uz: hal qiluvchi damda dovdirab qoladigan o'yinchi
general-unknown.ex: "He'll shank it. He's a choker. He doesn't have the nerve."

mnem.story: Muhim daqiqada bo'g'ilib-cho'kib qolgan o'yinchi — choker.

general-unknown.def: the claimed power to move objects using only the mind
general-unknown.ex: "How'd you do that?" — "Telekinesis." — "He blew on it."

mnem.story: Telefonni (tele) qo'l tekkizmay harakatga (kinesis) keltirish — telekinesis.

general-unknown.def: to make someone (often yourself) believe something that is not true
general-unknown.ex: "Your cousin is deluded or dishonest or both."

mnem.story: Lo'nda haqiqatni ko'rmay, o'zini aldab (delude) yurdi.

general-unknown.def: having the right to do or have something
general-unknown.ex: "No, no. He's entitled to his opinion."

mnem.story: Unvoni (title) borga huquq ham bor — u 'entitled'.

general-unknown.def: the way a person looks and behaves, which shows what they are like
general-unknown.ex: "It's obvious from your whole demeanor."

mnem.story: Minor kayfiyatda yurgan odamning butun o'zini tutishi (demeanor) shundoq ko'rinib turadi.

general-unknown.def: to move fast with a rushing sound, like air or water
general-unknown.ex: The car whooshed past and was gone.

mnem.story: Shamol 'shuvv' etib shuvillab (whoosh) o'tdi.

general-unknown.def: the state of there being nothing at all
general-unknown.ex: "There is no other side. This is it... and then nothingness."

mnem.story: 'Nothing'ga '-lik' (ness) qo'shsang — hechlik, ya'ni nothingness.

general-unknown.def: in a very short, almost rude way
senses: curt = brief to the point of rudeness
general-unknown.ex: "You were planning on refusing him very curtly."

mnem.story: Gapni 'qirt' etib kesdi — juda quruq (curtly) javob berdi.

general-unknown.def: living or lasting for ever
general-unknown.ex: "The kingdom of God is a real place, and you have an immortal soul."

mnem.story: 'Mortal' — o'ladigan; 'im-' qo'shilsa — o'lmas (immortal).

general-unknown.def: (informal) dishonest or silly behaviour
senses: mischief, playing around instead of working
general-unknown.ex: First week on the job, you want to set a tone. No monkey business.

mnem.story: Ofisda maymunlik (monkey business) qilma — birinchi kunoq ishdan haydashadi.

general-unknown.def: to grow well, be healthy and successful
senses: (of a business) to do very well
general-unknown.ex: The letter claimed the writer was thriving and happy.

mnem.story: Tirik va baquvvat daraxt bog'da gullab-yashnadi (thrive).

general-unknown.def: to breathe quickly and loudly after effort
senses: (of a dog) to breathe with its tongue out
general-unknown.ex: He was panting after running down the stairs.

mnem.story: Yugurib pand yegan yigit hansirab (panting) o'tirib qoldi.

general-unknown.def: to make a very loud, harsh noise
general-unknown.uz: qattiq va yoqimsiz ovoz chiqarmoq, gumburlamoq
senses: (of music or a horn) to sound too loudly
general-unknown.ex: Music was blaring from the open window.

mnem.story: Karnay baland ovozda gumburladi (blare) — quloq tomdi.

general-unknown.def: to try to win someone's love, or to try to gain something (attention, support)
general-unknown.uz: sovchi bo'lmoq, ko'ngil olmoq; e'tibor/xatarni o'ziga chorlamoq
general-unknown.ex: The letter says he will soon begin courting number twelve.

mnem.story: Qo'rqmay sovchi bo'lib bordi — uni 'court' qildi.

general-unknown.def: to say cruel things to someone to make them angry or upset
general-unknown.ex: Red John wouldn't risk capture just to taunt me.

mnem.story: Tovoniga tegib-tegib kalaka qildi (taunt) — bola yig'lab yubordi.

general-unknown.forms: track · tracks · off track · on track
general-unknown.def: away from the right direction or the right line of thinking
senses: on track = going correctly towards a goal
general-unknown.ex: "So the real killer is trying to throw us off track?"

mnem.story: Poyga trekidan chiqib ketgan mashina — 'off track'.

general-unknown.def: the use of science to examine evidence from a crime
general-unknown.ex: "Get those over to forensics."

mnem.story: Oq formadagi ekspertlar dalillarni mikroskopda tekshiradi — forensics.

general-unknown.def: to drink or eat with a loud sucking noise
general-unknown.ex: He sat there slurping his coffee.

mnem.story: Choyni 'shop-shop' shopirib ichdi (slurp) — hamma o'girilib qaradi.

general-unknown.def: in a strong, forceful or aggressive way
general-unknown.ex: "You protect your core self very fiercely."

mnem.story: Yirtqich hayvon bolasini shiddat bilan (fiercely) himoya qiladi.

general-unknown.def: like a devil; extremely cruel and evil
general-unknown.ex: He spoke about a cold, demonic evil.

mnem.story: Ertakdagi dev kabi shaytoniy (demonic) yovuzlik.

general-unknown.def: a person who does evil things
general-unknown.ex: He claimed he could see an image of the evildoer.

mnem.story: Yomonlikni (evil) qiladigan (doer) odam — evildoer.

general-unknown.def: to make someone suffer greatly in mind or body
general-unknown.ex: He described the killer as a lonely, tormented man.

mnem.story: Tor kamerada azob berishdi (torment) — jismonan ham, ruhan ham.

general-unknown.form: to be slandered in the media
general-unknown.def: to say false things about someone that damage their reputation
general-unknown.ex: "I do not like to be slandered in the media."

mnem.story: Yolg'on so'zlarni zanjirdek bog'lab, odamga tuhmat qildi (slander).

general-unknown.def: to make a long, high sound, as an old door or floor does
general-unknown.ex: The old stairs creaked under his feet.

mnem.story: Eski eshik 'g'ichhh' etib g'ichirladi (creak).

general-unknown.def: wood that is cut for burning
senses: uncountable: some firewood, not a firewood
general-unknown.ex: "I promised him a dollar if he cut the firewood."

mnem.story: Olov (fire) uchun yog'och (wood) — o'tin, ya'ni firewood.

general-unknown.def: strange and frightening, in a ghostly way
general-unknown.ex: "Is it really? Wow. That's spooky."

mnem.story: Arvoh (spook) yashaydigan uy — juda 'spooky'.

general-unknown.def: (informal, rude) stop talking nonsense and get to the point
general-unknown.uz: bekor gapni bas qil, lo'ndasini ayt
senses: rude — do not use it in exams or at work
general-unknown.ex: "Cut the crap. My brother's done nothing."

mnem.story: Ortiqcha gapni kes (cut) — lo'ndasini ayt.

general-unknown.def: (informal, rude) a very unpleasant, dishonest person
senses: scum = a worthless person or a dirty layer on liquid
general-unknown.ex: "You scumbags haven't got the stones to come after me."

mnem.story: Suv yuzasidagi iflos qatlam (scum) kabi pastkash odam — scumbag.

general-unknown.def: complete and obvious; also at top speed
senses: work flat out = work as hard as possible
a flat-out lie = a total lie
general-unknown.ex: "That is flat-out persecution."

mnem.story: Tekis (flat) va yalang'och haqiqat — 'flat-out', ya'ni ochiqdan-ochiq.

general-unknown.def: to treat someone cruelly and unfairly, especially over a long time
senses: often because of race, religion or beliefs
general-unknown.ex: "Rest assured, there's no intent to persecute you."

mnem.story: Pirini sekin-sekin ta'qib qilib (persecute), butun umr azob berishdi.

general-unknown.def: you can be certain — used to calm someone
general-unknown.ex: Rest assured, there is no intent to persecute you.

mnem.story: Suratdek aniq va'da: 'xotirjam bo'ling (rest assured), hammasi joyida'.

general-unknown.def: (of a bell or clock) to ring with a clear musical sound
senses: chime in = to join a conversation suddenly
general-unknown.ex: The clock chimed and everyone looked up.

mnem.story: Qo'ng'iroq 'chiyng' etib jaranglab (chime) ketdi.

general-unknown.def: (informal) a quick look; (literally) a male goose
general-unknown.uz: bir ko'z tashlash, qarab qo'yish; (asl ma'no) erkak g'oz
senses: take a gander = have a look
general-unknown.ex: "Maybe I should have a gander. I'm good at finding things."

mnem.story: G'oz bo'ynini cho'zib bir ko'z tashladi (have a gander).

general-unknown.def: funny in a light, pleasant way
general-unknown.ex: "That's very amusing." — "I try."

mnem.story: Muzda sirpanib yiqilgan do'stim juda kulgili (amusing) ko'rindi.

general-unknown.def: morally very bad, evil
general-unknown.ex: "You don't seem to be a wicked man. But you are."

mnem.story: Yovuz (wicked) odam yomon ishlarini daftariga kayd qilib yurardi.

general-unknown.def: the feeling inside you that tells you whether what you do is right or wrong
senses: a clear conscience = no feeling of guilt
general-unknown.ex: "I'm not a wicked man. My conscience is clear."

mnem.story: Vijdon (conscience) — ichingdagi kon, u senga ikkinchi shans beradi.

general-unknown.def: the crime of taking something that belongs to someone else
senses: identity theft = stealing someone's personal data
general-unknown.ex: "Money. Theft, he called it. Embezzlement."

mnem.story: O'g'ri oxirgi tiyingacha olib ketdi — mana sizga theft.

general-unknown.def: the crime of stealing money that your job lets you look after
general-unknown.uz: mansab pulini o'zlashtirish, kassa mablag'ini o'g'irlash
senses: different from ordinary theft: the money was entrusted to you
general-unknown.ex: Tannen called it theft — embezzlement.

mnem.story: Bezzat buxgalter kompaniya pulini emib (em) yubordi — embezzlement.

general-unknown.def: too sure that you are morally better than other people
general-unknown.ex: "Theft, he called it. Embezzlement. The self-righteous idiot."

mnem.story: O'zini (self) doim haq (right) deb biladigan qo'shni — self-righteous.

general-unknown.def: to take a sudden short breath because of surprise, shock or pain
senses: gasp for air = to struggle to breathe
general-unknown.ex: The frog jumped up and made her gasp, and then smile.

mnem.story: Qo'rqib g'ashi keldi va 'huh!' deb nafasi ichiga tushdi (gasp).

general-unknown.def: to remove unwanted people or things completely from a place or group
senses: to empty the body or the mind of something
general-unknown.ex: The new chief purged the department of corrupt officers.

mnem.story: Idorani pur (to'la) tozalab, hammani kechirmay quvib chiqardi (purge).

general-unknown.def: to let out a long, deep breath that shows you are tired, sad or relieved
general-unknown.uz: uh tortmoq, chuqur nafas olmoq (charchoq/afsus belgisi)
senses: a sigh of relief = a breath after worry ends
general-unknown.ex: She sighed and put the cup down on the table.

mnem.story: Soy bo'yida o'tirib, charchoqdan chuqur uh tortdi (sigh).
